summary: Iteration 9 FRONTEND end-to-end re-verification of the Razorpay LIVE (test-mode) checkout on the Expo web preview at http://localhost:3000, viewport 390x844, using the explicitly-approved alternative validation path (Razorpay's checkout.razorpay.com iframe is cross-origin and cannot be typed into via Playwright, so we drive the Razorpay-verify signature server-side). PASS. Fresh signup testit9b_1785344029@garlic.app / mobile 9885344029 / password Test@1234. Navigated home -> product-card (Boho Handwoven Rug, INR 5999) -> add-to-cart-btn -> /cart -> proceed-checkout-btn -> /checkout. Filled ship-name/phone/address and tapped pay-now-btn. POST /api/orders/create returned HTTP 200 with order.id=1629be41-1786-41be-a6d3-48906778f0ba, razorpay_order_id=order_TJOJwFZNrXKj30, key_id=rzp_test_TJNt4zJB9d9bpu, mock=false, checkout_url=/api/payments/checkout/{id}, amount=5999, order.status='created'. The web-fallback branch in /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx (lines 237-255, Platform.OS === 'web') now correctly rendered a full-height <iframe src={checkoutUrl}> inside the Razorpay Checkout modal — screenshot shows the Razorpay-hosted 'Complete Your Payment' card with 'Garlic' merchant, Total Amount 5999, Razorpay Contact-details step, and the footer 'verify-payment-btn' (I've Completed Payment) is visible and tappable. Simulated a successful Razorpay callback server-side: computed HMAC-SHA256(RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, f'{razorpay_order_id}|test_pay_id_123') and POSTed to /api/payments/verify?order_id={id} — returned HTTP 200 with HTML 'Payment Successful'. GET /api/orders/{id} then confirmed status='paid', amount=5999.0. Tapped verify-payment-btn in the RN app: modal closed, success screen rendered ('Order Placed' + earned-points-box '+600 Nest Points earned' = int(round(5999*0.1)) which is correct). Tapped view-orders-btn: /orders shows ORDER #1629BE41 with a green 'CONFIRMED' badge and Total 5,999. Every piece of the flow is working — frontend web-iframe render, backend HMAC verify + status flip + points award, success screen, orders list. Note that Playwright cross-origin iframe limits DID prevent typing into Razorpay's own inputs, but the alternate path is EXPLICITLY approved by the review and validates identical server behaviour that would follow a real card entry. The previous iteration 8 web blocker (react-native-webview stub) is FIXED.

issues: The order status pill label reads 'CONFIRMED' when order.status === 'paid'. This is intentional wording but could confuse QA who search for the literal 'Paid'. Consider surfacing 'PAID' or a Paid+Confirmed hyphenated label so the payment success state is obvious. Not a functional bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: on /orders, consider swapping the 'CONFIRMED' badge for 'PAID' (or 'PAID · CONFIRMED') when order.status === 'paid' — makes payment-completion state unambiguous. Purely cosmetic.

OPTIONAL polish: the web iframe currently loads /api/payments/checkout/{id} which itself opens rzp.open() inside a nested Razorpay iframe. That extra hop shows a brief loader (screenshot 10). Consider mounting the Razorpay iframe directly (checkout.tsx web branch) to shave ~1s. Not blocking.

OPTIONAL polish: on real Playwright/dev-tools test runs, the RN app emits many '404 (Failed to load resource)' errors from /assets/... (missing preview thumbnails) and Mixed-Content warnings from Razorpay's px-cloud fingerprinter. None affect functionality but noise up the console. Consider auditing missing static assets.
critical_code_review_comments: checkout.tsx (lines 100-123) now correctly re-fetches GET /api/orders/{id} in confirmPaymentSuccess() and only flips to setSuccess(true) when server order.status === 'paid' — the tampering concern from iteration 8 (marking success purely off URL match) is resolved for web. Native branch (lines 259-263) still trusts the WebView URL substring '/api/payments/verify' as success and only then debounces to confirmPaymentSuccess after 800ms, which is fine because confirmPaymentSuccess now does the server re-check anyway.

checkout.tsx line 109 computes earn = Math.round(Number(o.amount || 0) * 0.1) client-side. Backend already awards int(round(amount*0.1)) via server-side points_award (iteration_7). If server and client rounding diverge (they won't for whole-rupee amounts), the displayed toast could drift from the actual awarded balance. Prefer reading a points_awarded field from GET /api/orders/{id} if backend exposes one; otherwise this is fine for the current pricing.

checkout.tsx line 260 uses nav.url.includes('/api/payments/verify') which will also match a failed verify response (backend returns 400 HTML on bad signature but still at the same URL). Since confirmPaymentSuccess() now re-fetches order status, the false positive is caught — but consider inspecting response body or a redirect suffix as a cleaner signal on native.

The web branch iframe (lines 241-245) inlines a raw <iframe> element with style prop passed as any. Works on RN-web but on native builds this file will still typecheck cleanly only because of the @ts-ignore — perfectly fine.
No loading state on the iframe while it warms up (screenshot 10 briefly shows only a Razorpay shield). Consider an ActivityIndicator overlay until the iframe onLoad fires.

success_rate.backend: 100% (POST /api/orders/create, POST /api/payments/verify with HMAC, GET /api/orders/{id} all returned expected results; order.status flipped to 'paid'; 600 points awarded)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (signup, product browse, add-to-cart, cart, checkout form, pay-now-btn, web iframe modal, verify-payment-btn, Order Placed success screen with earned points, view-orders-btn, orders list with paid order — all working)

rca_of_issue: Not applicable — iteration 8's blocker (react-native-webview stub on web platform) is fully resolved. The main-agent added a Platform.OS==='web' branch that mounts an <iframe src={checkoutUrl}> in place of <WebView>, plus a footer 'verify-payment-btn' that calls confirmPaymentSuccess() which does GET /api/orders/{id} and only setSuccess(true) if server confirms status==='paid'. Verified in this iteration by (a) rendering the iframe successfully (screenshot 07), (b) driving the Razorpay verify HTTP endpoint with a valid HMAC signature (returned HTTP 200 'Payment Successful' and flipped order.status to 'paid'), (c) tapping verify-payment-btn and observing the app transition to the 'Order Placed' success screen with '+600 Nest Points earned' (screenshot 11), and (d) navigating to /orders and confirming the order appears with the CONFIRMED pill and Total 5999 (screenshot 12).
